target.title: Root workspace uses Turbo and Yarn PnP
target.test: The repository root must be a private Turbo monorepo using Yarn Plug'n'Play workspaces for apps and packages.

steps.instruction: Inspect package.json, .yarnrc.yml, turbo.json, tsconfig.json, and tsconfig.base.json.
steps.expected: Root package.json is private, declares apps/* and packages/* workspaces, has turbo-backed build/test/deploy scripts, .yarnrc.yml uses pnp, turbo.json exists, and root tsconfig references workspace projects.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable and yarn build.
steps.expected: Both commands complete successfully without creating node_modules.

target.passCriteria: The root workspace contract is implemented and buildable through Turbo.

steps.descript: Root manifests implement the Turbo monorepo contract.
evidence: package.json has private true and workspaces ["apps/*","packages/*"].
turbo.json defines build/test tasks and tsconfig.json references packages/ndx, apps/ndx, and apps/ndxserver.

target.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable and yarn build.
target.expected: Both commands complete successfully without creating node_modules.

steps.descript: Immutable install and Turbo build completed successfully.
evidence: yarn build exited 0 with 4 successful Turbo tasks.
.gitignore excludes node_modules and no workspace node_modules tree was created.

result.descript: The root workspace is a buildable Turbo/Yarn PnP monorepo.
evidence: Root manifests inspected in package.json, .yarnrc.yml, turbo.json, tsconfig.json, and tsconfig.base.json.
Commands passed: yarn install --immutable; yarn build.
